security.readOnly: Only owners can change these settings. You can review them here.
security.personal.title: Not available for personal workspaces
security.personal.description: Create or switch to an organization to manage enterprise security.
security.noAccess.title: You don't have access
security.noAccess.description: Ask an owner of this organization for access.
security.secret.once: Copy this now. It is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later.
security.errors.ssoUnavailable: Enterprise SSO is not enabled for the 4mica sign-in service yet, so nothing was saved.
security.errors.wouldLockOut: This allowlist would lock you out. Add your current IP ({{ip}}) first.
security.errors.identityNotManaged: Only members whose email is on one of your verified domains can be signed out everywhere.
security.domains.title: Domains
security.domains.description: Prove you own your email domains to enable single sign-on, automatic joining and managed sign-outs.
security.domains.invalid: Enter a domain name such as example.com.
security.domains.recordHint: Create this DNS TXT record at your DNS provider, wait for it to propagate, then select Verify.
security.domains.autoJoin: Let people on this domain join automatically
security.domains.autoJoinHint: Anyone signing in with a verified @{{domain}} email becomes a member with the role on the right.
security.domains.autoJoinRole: Role for people who join automatically
security.domains.deleteBody: Single sign-on connections for this domain are turned off as well.
security.sso.title: Single sign-on
security.sso.description: Connect a SAML identity provider for a verified domain.
security.sso.ownerOnly: Only owners can view and manage single sign-on connections.
security.sso.needsDomain: Verify a domain first. Connections are tied to a verified domain.
security.sso.deleteBody: The connection is removed from the sign-in service. Members sign in with their usual method again.
security.sso.spHint: Give these values to your identity provider when you register 4mica as an application.
security.sso.enforceHint: Members with an @{{domain}} email must sign in through this connection.
security.sso.enforceNeedsActive: Activate the connection before requiring it.
security.sso.enforceBody: Every member with an @{{domain}} email will have to sign in through your identity provider. Anyone signed in another way is signed out of this organization on their next request.
security.sso.enforceBodyNote: Test the connection with your own account first. CLI tokens and API keys keep working.
security.sso.createDescription: The connection starts inactive, so you can test it before members depend on it.
security.sso.unavailable: Enterprise SSO must be enabled on the 4mica sign-in service (the Clerk instance) before a connection can be created. Nothing was saved. Contact 4mica support to enable it.
security.sso.fields.name: Connection name
security.sso.fields.metadataUrlHint: 4mica reads the entity ID, sign-in URL and certificate from it.
security.sso.fields.certificateHint: Paste the PEM certificate. It is passed to the sign-in service and not stored by 4mica.
security.sso.fields.defaultRoleHint: Given to people who join through this connection.
security.sso.fields.jitHint: People who sign in through this connection join automatically with the default role.
security.sso.errors.name: Give the connection a name.
security.sso.errors.certificate: Paste a PEM certificate that starts with -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----.
security.sso.provider.OKTA.title: Okta
security.sso.provider.OKTA.hint: In Okta, create a SAML 2.0 app integration and copy its metadata URL from the Sign On tab.
security.sso.provider.MICROSOFT_ENTRA.hi: In Entra, add a non-gallery enterprise application, choose SAML, and copy the App Federation Metadata URL.
security.sso.provider.GOOGLE_WORKSPACE.h: In the Admin console, add a custom SAML app. Google shows the SSO URL, entity ID and certificate; enter them manually.
security.sso.provider.CUSTOM.title: Other SAML provider
security.sso.provider.CUSTOM.hint: Any SAML 2.0 identity provider works. Use its metadata URL, or enter the entity ID, sign-in URL and certificate.
security.policies.title: Access policies
security.policies.description: Rules every member must meet to use this organization.
security.policies.requireMfaHint: Members without a second factor are asked to set one up before they can continue.
security.policies.sessionMaxAgeHint: From 1 to 720. Members sign in again after this long. Leave empty for no limit.
security.policies.reauthWindowHint: From 1 to 240. Sensitive changes need a sign-in this recent.
security.policies.ipAllowlistHint: Dashboard and CLI access is allowed only from these addresses. One address or CIDR range per line; empty allows any.
security.policies.currentIp: Your current IP address is {{ip}}. Saving would lock you out.
security.policies.enforceForApiKeys: Apply the allowlist to API keys
security.policies.enforceForApiKeysHint: Requests with any API key of this organization must come from an allowed address.
security.policies.errors.sessionMaxAge: Enter a whole number from 1 to 720, or leave empty.
security.policies.errors.reauthWindow: Enter a whole number from 1 to 240.
security.permission.resources.write: Create and edit agents and APIs
security.roles.title: Roles
security.roles.description: Custom roles sit alongside the built-in ones. Owner-only permissions can't be granted.
security.roles.readOnly: Only owners can create or change custom roles.
security.roles.emptyHint: Create one to give a group exactly the access it needs.
security.roles.deleteBody_one: {{count}} member has this role. They fall back to Viewer.
security.roles.deleteBody_other: {{count}} members have this role. They fall back to Viewer.
security.roles.formDescription: Members with this role get exactly these permissions.
security.roles.fields.name: Name
security.roles.fields.projectRoleHint: Applies to unrestricted projects. An explicit project membership wins.
security.roles.fields.permissionsHint: Only permissions that can be delegated are listed.
security.scim.tokensDescription: Your identity provider authenticates to 4mica with one of these bearer tokens.
security.scim.revokeBody: Provisioning with this token stops immediately.
security.scim.groupsDescription: Groups pushed by your identity provider. A member gets the role of their highest-priority mapped group, otherwise Viewer.
security.streams.title: Streams
security.streams.description: Each stream receives signed batches of audit events.
security.streams.readOnly: Only owners can create or change audit streams.
security.streams.createDescription: Events are posted as JSON to your HTTPS endpoint every 30 seconds.
security.streams.fields.name: Name
security.streams.fields.urlHint: Must be https:// on a public host. Redirects are not followed.
security.streams.fields.prefixesHint: Comma-separated action prefixes. Leave empty to send every event.
security.streams.fields.backfillHint: Optional, up to 90 days back. Without it the stream starts with new events only.
security.streams.errors.backfill: Choose a date within the last 90 days.
security.streams.rotateBody: Deliveries are signed with the new secret right away. Update your receiver before the next batch.
security.streams.deleteBody: No more events are sent to this endpoint.
security.report.key.name: Key
